repositories.name: ChagptClone
repositories.description: A full-stack AI chat application that mimics ChatGPT's functionality with a clean, responsive interface. Built with Next.js, TypeScript, and Supabase, it enables users to have natural conversations with an AI assistant powered by Google's Gemini API

repositories.name: Portfolio
repositories.description: This modern portfolio showcases my skills, projects, and experience as a frontend developer. It is designed to be fully responsive and visually appealing, providing an interactive user experience.

repositories.name: Fizzi
repositories.description: Fizzi is a modern 3D product showcase website built with Next.js, TypeScript, Three.js, GSAP, and Prismic. It features smooth scroll-triggered animations and interactive 3D visuals. Content is dynamically managed using Prismic CMS. Designed for high performance, responsiveness, and an engaging user experience.

repositories.name: user-manage
repositories.description: The User Management App is a React-based application that allows users to log in, view a paginated list of users, edit user details, and delete users using the Reqres API. It includes authentication with token persistence, protected routes, and error handling to ensure a seamless experience. The application is built with React, React Router, Axios.

repositories.name: Todo-React
repositories.description: A simple and efficient To-Do app built with React and Tailwind CSS. The app allows users to add, edit, delete, and mark tasks as completed. All tasks are stored in local storage, ensuring data persistence across sessions.

repositories.name: Quiz-App
repositories.description: Quiz Launchpad is an interactive quiz application that offers a fun and engaging way for users to test their knowledge. With a space-themed design and dynamic animations, this app provides an immersive user experience right from the login screen.

repositories.name: Apna-Bazar
repositories.description: A modern e-commerce platform for seamless online shopping, offering a wide range of products with interactive features and a user-friendly experience.
